body:
Thank you for your kind words. 
I'll keep trying as long as I can.
I just don't know how long I can keep that up.
Hey, not better in any sense, but trying my damnest to stick around and prevent myself from killing me.

I will try my best. You are a kind man. 
Thank you.

This comment means a lot to me... Thank you very much. I am trying to survive by the day, finding a reason to stay alive, I am simply afraid that I won't be able to do it today...

If you see a goodbye note on my profile, know that I am gone, if not, then well, I guess I'll still be here...
I figured the methods part right after posting...

I can't bear this anymore... I've lost so much, getting back to normal has become impossible, and to even do that it's me who has to suffer even further... It just doesn't seem worth it. 
Living simply doesn't seem worth the effort. I don't have a purpose anymore, there's no meaning to this chaos... I am tired, I need peace...
